title: 模型图片输入与资料引用增强

security_summary.evidence_gate: catalog_support_image, protocol_state and capability_state are separate; a catalog flag alone can only produce UNVERIFIED; AVAILABLE requires a ProtocolProfile with SYNTHETIC_TRANSPORT or LIVE_READ evidence
security_summary.production_default: the shipped ProtocolRegistry is empty, so every image call fails with MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED before resolving a reference, reading a byte or sending a request
security_summary.input_shape: images is an array of {media_id} references only; paths, URLs, headers, raw bytes and unknown fields are rejected; account, task and staging root are host-bound and absent from the tool schema
security_summary.send_path: MediaAssets.manifest -> prepare_model_bundle -> authorize_model_send -> consume_model_bundle; each OutboundImage is re-checked for media_id, MIME, byte size and sha256 before staging
security_summary.staging: one 0600 file per selected image under a 0700 root, named by a 32-hex token; Node reads an exact name and byte count with symlink refusal and sha256 verification, deletes the file immediately after reading, and Python deletes leftovers in finally; crash residue is swept after 900 seconds
security_summary.scope: only the named references are resolved and staged; a neighbouring file in the same directory is never opened
security_summary.limits: protocol limits may only narrow the frozen engineering maxima (4 images, 8 MiB per image, 16 MiB total, 16 million pixels)
security_summary.cancellation: CANCELLED revokes the task's media, deletes staged files and never replays; the one unopened 401 auth recovery keeps the same model and the same image set and records image_input.sends=2 with automatic_replay=false
security_summary.usage: only upstream usage is reported; missing usage stays null with usage_state UNKNOWN and is never derived from image count
security_summary.source_mapping: ORIGINAL_QUOTE, DERIVED_IMAGE, USER_INPUT and TEXT_SUMMARY are distinct; derived images keep source_sha256 -> sha256 conversion chains; citations only prove identifier registration and claim_verified is always false
security_summary.leak_control: errors and evidence carry counts, identifiers and hashes only, never image encoding, prompt text, staging paths or credentials
security_summary.network_during_preparation: the media boundary performs no network request; the model transport is the only outbound path

baseline_comparison.worktree: detached 323a98b with the same node_modules link
baseline_comparison.note: the 41 added tests are the only delta; no existing test changed state

validators.contracts: ok, 8 contracts / 9 schema samples / 35 rejection samples / 8 extra samples / 29 legacy tools

checks.environment_note: a fresh worktree has no src/thu_assistant/node_modules; without linking the installed dependencies 19 gateway/session tests fail for a missing tough-cookie module on both the baseline and this tree, so the link is an environment prerequisite, not a module result

acceptance.case: existing single-turn and multi-turn text requests keep parameters and result type
a catalogue flag without transport evidence refuses instead of guessing the request body
another account, an expired reference or an over-limit selection produces zero fake remote requests
the send scope is exactly the selected text and images and never reads a neighbour file
unknown citation ids are flagged and known ids are never claimed as verified facts
cancellation or a stream interruption after output starts never triggers a second generation
missing usage and partial output keep UNKNOWN and incomplete states
logs, errors, progress and handover text carry no image encoding or prompt text

cross_module_requests.request: Wire models.chat(media=..., protocols=...): build MediaAssets from the 2.1 temp_dir, a MediaBinding from the authenticated account pseudonym, a per-request task id and <temp_dir>/transport created 0700; expose the already-extended images argument on model_chat and do not add another local read path or image_url/path field.

Register the new module codes in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json: MODEL_REQUIRED_FOR_IMAGE_INPUT, MODEL_IMAGE_SELECTION_INVALID, MODEL_IMAGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, MODEL_IMAGE_UNSUPPORTED, MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED, MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE, MODEL_IMAGE_TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE, MODEL_IMAGE_STAGING_FAILED, MODEL_IMAGE_STAGING_MISMATCH, MODEL_IMAGE_MESSAGES_INVALID. Until then they classify as INTERNAL and are never replayed.
Optionally attach model_media.capabilities(directory, protocols=...) rows to list_models; never promote a catalog flag to AVAILABLE.

Document the gated image capability (current build returns MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED for image calls; text, catalog and the 29 tool entries are unchanged). 4.5 did not edit docs/CAPABILITIES.md because 4.1/4.2/4.3 share it and 7.3 owns the public manual.
Include tests/test_model_media.py in cross-platform regression; the Node transport cases need a node executable and the POSIX permission case skips on Windows.
Ship src/thu_assistant/model_media.py in the wheel (pure Python; no package-data entry needed).

blockers.impact: Every image call refuses with MODEL_IMAGE_PROTOCOL_UNVERIFIED; text chat, the catalog and the existing 29 tool entries are unaffected.
blockers.resolution: Record a ProtocolProfile only after official documentation or an owner-authorized synthetic probe defines the request media shape, supported models, byte/pixel/count limits and error semantics.

remaining_limits: The module's completion means the gate, preview, send path, source mapping and refusal paths are implemented; it does not mean multimodal input works against the real school proxy.

Transport staging writes a second copy of already-sanitised image bytes beside the 3.3 cache: 0600 files under a 0700 root, deleted after a verified read or in finally, with crash residue swept after 900 seconds; no physical erasure is claimed.
The gateway stdin frame limit of 2 MiB is why inline base64 is not used; if 6.1 changes the framing protocol this decision must be re-checked.
Images attach only to the final user message; earlier assistant turns keep their original shape and images are never retro-inserted.
Protocol evidence is matched per exact model id with no wildcard; different proxy paths for one model need separate profiles.
Capability rows use the frozen model-image-capability-v1 object, so media types and limits live in preview.protocol rather than in the row.
Windows has no POSIX mode bits; staging privacy relies on the user-directory ACL and the module only rejects relative paths, symlinks and non-directories.
A 401 that arrives before output may resend the same images once for token refresh; the evidence records image_input.sends=2 and automatic_replay=false, and the model never changes.
rollback: Stop injecting MediaBinding and ProtocolRegistry: image arguments then fail with MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE while text chat, the catalog and the 29 tool entries are unchanged. THU_MODEL_READ=0 still returns to the legacy single-prompt behaviour. Nothing is re-sent, and user files are never deleted.
next_step: The batch integrator reconnects 4.1-4.5 on one commit, runs the batch-level check, the full offline suite and contract linkage, then the repair phase records acceptance; the protocol-evidence blocker stays open until verified evidence exists.
